newsitem.title: USA: Greenville County, S.C., hospital merger off.
newsitem.headline: Greenville County, S.C., hospital merger off.

text.p: Voters in Greenville, S.C., roundly defeated a proposed merger of their hosptial system with two nearby hospital groups, an official of the Greenville County Board of Elections and Voter Registration said Wednesday.
About 75 percent, or 90,260 voters, turned down the proposal, while 28,804 said yes to the proposed merger, according to the official.
The merger would have combined the public Greenville Hospital System into a new non-profit system with Spartanburg Regional Healthcare System and Anderson Area Medical Center.
